title: Appreciating and Supporting the Well-being of Educators in Singapore
what_it_is: Appreciating and Supporting the Well-being of Educators in Singapore

sections.label: Guidelines to protect teachers
sections.summary: The speaker calls on the Ministry to give guidelines or empowerment so principals and teachers can report rude or harsh incidents to authorities for self-protection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: At times, it is much worse when parents do the same towards their children's teachers just to defend their wrongdoings and hide beneath their "guilt-tripping behaviours".

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Hence, I call on the Ministry to give guidelines or even empowerment to school principals or even the victimised teachers to report any rude or harsh incidents teachers faced to the relevant authorities, as a means of self-protection from any abusive behaviours from both parents and students.

sections.label: Teacher union grievance cases
sections.summary: The speaker says teacher unions receive more than 1,000 cases of grievances annually, aside from feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I also managed to speak to few friends and cousins who are currently teaching too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is to my surprise that annually, these unions received more than 1,000 cases of grievances alone, aside from feedbacks.

sections.label: Teacher pay revision and retention
sections.summary: The speaker cites a recent announcement of teacher pay revision of 5% to 10%, a new grade, and a 30-year retention scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One recent example was the recent announcement of pay revision and increase for teachers ranging between 5% and 10%, the introduction of a new grade; and a 30-year retention scheme which hopefully can motivate our teachers to continue their careers in educating our children and students.

sections.label: School leadership and teacher support
sections.summary: The speaker says school leadership affects school culture, work-life harmony, workload, expectations and shielding teachers, and puts forward three areas for MOE's consideration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Collectively, school leadership plays a pivotal role in school culture, work-life harmony, workload, expectations of teachers as well as shielding teachers from abusive parents and students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Hence, I would like to put forward three areas for MOE's consideration for more support for our teachers.

sections.label: Non-teaching duties and messages
sections.summary: The speaker says loading teachers with committee work, non-teaching duties, meetings and constant WhatsApp messages is unwise and untenable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: To then load them with committee work, non-teaching-related duties and meetings as well as constant, non-stop WhatsApp messages from multiple chat groups is unwise and untenable.

sections.label: Respecting teachers' personal hours
sections.summary: The speaker appeals to parents to respect teachers' personal hours and not indiscriminately send messages or e-mails or expect immediate responses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: On this note, I appeal to all parents with school-going children to respect the teachers' personal hours and not to indiscriminately send messages, e-mails, or worse, expect a response as soon as possible.

sections.label: Teacher feedback and pandemic bonus
sections.summary: The ministry and school principals should accept feedback openly and avoid marking teachers down in appraisals, and the Minister for Education is asked to consider a special bonus for teachers' pandemic workload.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Above and beyond getting feedback, the ministry and school principals should accept it with an open mind and avoid punishing those teachers by marking them down in their annual appraisal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Abdul Samad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: (In English): I am appealing to the Minister for Education to consider a special bonus to recognise our teachers for their effort in managing extraordinary workload and stresses during the pandemic while continuing to educate our students.

sections.label: MOE salary adjustment welcomed
sections.summary: The speaker, on behalf of Teachers' Unions and Education Cluster of Unions, joins Abdul Samad in welcoming MOE's recent move to adjust salaries by 5% to 10% for teachers and educators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Speaking on behalf of all our Teachers' Unions and Education Cluster of Unions, I join hon Member Abdul Samad in welcoming the recent move by MOE to adjust salaries by between 5% and 10% for their teachers and educators.

sections.label: New GEO 5A substantive grade
sections.summary: One important and welcomed enhancement announced is the new GEO 5A substantive grade.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: One important and welcomed enhancement announced is the new GEO 5A substantive grade.

sections.label: Group-level exam paper setting
sections.summary: The speaker suggests all exam papers be set at group or cluster level for mainstream Primary, Secondary and college levels to save time and increase uniformity, consistency and alignment, especially during the pandemic when prelim results are used as a proxy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Can I suggest that all exam papers be set at a group or cluster level for all our mainstream levels – Primary, Secondary including college – so that time can be saved and there is greater uniformity, consistency and alignment especially such as during the pandemic, where prelim results are used as a proxy when the student is unable to undertake national exams.

sections.label: Student care educators' low salaries
sections.summary: For student care educators specifically, salaries are disproportionately low compared to the deliverables and expectations placed on them by parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: In fact, for student care educators specifically, their salaries are disproportionately low when compared to the deliverables and expectations on them by parents.

sections.label: Polytechnic and ITE salary reviews
sections.summary: Polytechnics and ITE review staff salaries periodically to keep them competitive against market benchmarks and are conducting a review currently.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Our Polytechnics and ITE also review the salaries of the staff periodically, to ensure that salaries remain competitive against market benchmarks and are conducting a review currently.

sections.label: Teacher Work Attachment Plus programme
sections.summary: Teachers are encouraged to gain experiences beyond the classroom, and MOE partners with public and private sectors through TWA+ for short-term attachments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We encourage teachers to gain diverse experiences beyond the classroom, so that they can broaden their perspectives and benefit from personal and professional growth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We have partnered with the public and private sectors through the Teacher Work Attachment Plus (TWA+) programme, so teachers can take up short-term attachments to enhance their skills and build connections.

sections.label: Protecting teachers from harassment
sections.summary: In extreme situations where teachers feel threatened or harassed, schools may call the Police and use legal protection.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: In extreme situations where the teachers feel threatened or harassed, or their safety is being compromised, the school may take further action, including calling the Police for assistance and using legal protection for our teachers, to protect them against further harassment.

sections.label: Reducing teachers' administrative work
sections.summary: Administrative work was reduced through centralised services and technology like Parents Gateway and Student Learning Space, and other ways will be considered.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We have reduced administrative work by strengthening centralised services and leveraging technology, such as Parents Gateway and Student Learning Space, to streamline processes and teaching resources.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We will consider other ways to create capacity for our educators, including Mr Patrick Tay's suggestion for common exam papers to be set across schools.

sections.label: School-home partnership guidelines
sections.summary: Parents are asked to work with educators to support children's learning, per MOE guidelines on school-home partnership published in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Work together with the educators to support your children's learning and complement the learning with what can be done at home.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: These guidelines on school-home partnership were published by MOE in 2019 and are available online.

sections.label: Teachers' Day appreciation messages
sections.summary: Over 20,000 messages from students, parents and alumni were received on the Thank You 'Cher portal during Teachers' Day this month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: I am heartened by the outpouring of appreciation and gratitude to our educators on our Thank You 'Cher portal during Teachers' Day this month.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: There have been over 20,000 messages received from students, parents and alumni.

sections.label: Supporting educators' workload
sections.summary: MOE is committed to ensuring educators remain well-supported with manageable workload, so they can bring out the best in children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: MOE is committed to ensuring that they continue to be well-supported and their workload remains manageable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: When our educators are well supported, they will be able to bring out the best in our children, the future of our nation.
